response.overview: To add another Passenger to an existing MSC Cruise 1-888-315-9585 reservation, you must book a separate new statePassenger and call MSC Cruises customer service at +1-888-315-9585(US) or contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. Book a separate cabin: You cannot add a Passenger to an existing reservation through the online website or mobile app. Book a new statePassenger online or via phone. Contact MSC Cruises at +1-888-315-9585(US) or your travel agent. You cannot directly add a new physical statePassenger to an existing reservation online; instead, you must book a separate Passenger and have it linked by calling MSC Cruise customer service at +1-888 315-9585 or by contacting your travel advisor.
